messages:
sam-sales: Hey all — trying to get FoxPoint POC over the finish line. They need a cleared Order Form + MSA/DPA redlines before they'll cut a PO. Can legal confirm any absolute blockers? Also finance asked if we can do Net30 vs Net45 and if we can show KMS/HSM support for private.

olivia-legal: Quick read: two main asks are problematic if left as-is: (1) Liability cap at 3x annual fees — we're comfortable with our standard of max(\"$250,000\", fees paid in prior 12 months). If they insist on 3x, we'll need Exec approval. (2) DPA: they want data residency + an addendum that restricts subprocessors and requires prior consent for new subprocessors. We can accept a DPA addendum with Appendix A (updatable list + 30d notice). Who's the signing counterparty?

ben-ps: Pricing note: POC used Dedicated burst. If they move to a Dedicated commit, price per GPU-hour drops. I updated quote_v3 (https://redwood.example/quote/FP-2345) with Net30/Net45 columns — Net30 has a slightly lower finance discount. We should show both options.

maya-cs: They also requested SOC 2 Type II and a SAML SSO plan. We can provide SOC2 report under NDA. SAML integration will take ~2 weeks for the POC team to complete (depends on their IdP SAML metadata).

ciara-ops: KMS/HSM: for Private deployment we support customer-managed KMS via our Vault/HSM integration. I'll assemble an attestation + config checklist and key-rotation policy. We can provide runbook steps for onboarding keys and an example terraform snippet if they want automation.

sam-sales: Olivia — can Legal draft concrete proposed redline text for the liability cap and the DPA Appendix A so I can send it to FoxPoint? If Exec approval might be required, call that out now so we can avoid blocking on Friday.

olivia-legal: Drafting now. Proposed liability language: "Supplier's aggregate liability shall not exceed the greater of $250,000 or the fees paid by Customer to Supplier under the Order Form during the 12 months preceding the claim." DPA addendum: add Appendix A (maintained by Supplier; notice of new subprocessors 30 days). If they still push 3x cap we need VP Legal/GC sign-off — ETA for that review ~48 hours after escalation.

sam-sales: For signature flow they said two signers: Procurement (to issue PO) and Finance (for invoice/ACH). Recommend we request Procurement first. Any objections to routing: procurement -> counterparty legal -> sam-sales@redwood -> finance@redwood ?

ben-ps: That order looks good. Also include a PO_NUMBER field on the Order Form. Example DocuSign routing payload I use: 

```json
{
  "signing_order": [
    "procurement@foxpoint.com",
    "legal@foxpoint.com",
    "sam-sales@redwood.com",
    "finance@redwood.com"
  ],
  "fields": {
    "PO_NUMBER_REQUIRED": true
  }
}
```

olivia-legal: Add a clause allowing wet-ink alternative if their ERP requires physical signature processing. Also request countersignature date alignment (effective upon last signature) to avoid ambiguity.

ciara-ops: I'll upload KMS attestation + rotation policy + example terraform snippet to a secure share and post link here by EOD. Also note: for HSM-backed keys we require a provisioning lead time of ~7 business days once contract is signed.

contract-bot: Reminder: Order Form template must include Billing cadence field (Net30/Net45) and PO number placeholder; set PO_NUMBER_REQUIRED = true if customer confirms sending PO.

sam-sales: Plan: 1) Send Legal's redline draft to FoxPoint with rationale; 2) Share quote_v3 with both billing options; 3) Create DocuSign envelope with the routing above and set PO field required if they confirm a PO. I'll ping when live. :thumbsup:

olivia-legal: Uploading redlines to private share (NDAs in place) and will call out Exec escalation path in the doc if they don't accept proposed cap.

maya-cs: I'll DM their security lead to request SOC2 NDA and schedule SAML kickoff for next Tuesday.

ben-ps: Heads-up: if they pick Dedicated commit we'll need 60-day provisioning notice for reserved capacity. Flagging for their procurement team so they can align PO timing.

sam-sales: Any other procurement/payment blockers (treasury approvals, export control, tax withholding)? If not I'll start outreach now.

olivia-legal: Not from Legal beyond what's noted. :white_check_mark:
